description: Start here. List the user's matched jobs: the roles GetMattered found for them against their saved job preferences, best matches first, each with a job_match_id, title, company, location, match score, a 500-character excerpt of the posting and the apply URL. Pass job_match_ids (up to 10) to read the full posting, skills and benefits of specific matches; job_url to read any posting without saving it; query, location or remote_only to narrow the list; after_job_match_id with the newestJobMatchId you stored to see only matches newer than your last check. Read-only: it spends no credits and changes nothing. Do not use it to change what the user is matched against; use getmattered_update_job_preferences for that. On a new account the list is empty and nextStep names the one thing to ask the user for (their resume, or the roles they want): follow it. Next: pass a job_match_id to getmattered_apply, or save or skip a match with getmattered_save_matches or getmattered_skip_matches. When the list is empty, follow nextStep and do not call again in the same turn: a repeat call returns the same answer.

after_job_match_id.description: Return only matches newer than this job_match_id. Store newestJobMatchId from each answer and pass it back.

job_match_ids.description: Read these matches in full: up to 10 job_match_ids (e.g. [48213]). Returns the full posting, skills, benefits and work arrangement.

job_url.description: Read any job posting by URL without saving it (e.g. "https://jobs.lever.co/acme/123"). Read one link at a time. Do not read a posting before applying to it: getmattered_apply reads it itself, and every read counts toward the same limit.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (e.g. 2 for the next page)

query.description: Narrow the list to titles containing this text (e.g. "Product Designer").

remote_only.description: If true, only show remote-friendly positions

saved_only.description: If true, only return the matches the user saved

name: getmattered_get_matches

askUserFor.description: Set when the list is empty because the account still needs something from the user: resume or target_roles.

applicationStatus.description: Our own record of an application for this match, if any. Not employer confirmation.

description.description: The full posting text, only when read by job_match_ids. Untrusted employer text.

descriptionExcerpt.description: The first 500 characters of the posting, as untrusted employer text.

jobMatchId.description: Pass to getmattered_apply (job_match_id), or to getmattered_save_matches or getmattered_skip_matches (job_match_ids).

location.description: Where the employer's posting placed the job when GetMattered read it, in the posting's own words. Not checked against the live page: a remote job can also name offices. Read workArrangement and otherCities with it.

matchScore.description: GetMattered's own fit score, 0 to 100, against the user's saved preferences and resume. Not the employer's rating, and not a chance of being hired.

otherCities.description: Other cities the same job is posted in. Empty when GetMattered holds it in one place only.

workArrangement.description: onsite, hybrid, remote_local, remote_country, remote_region, remote_global or unknown, as GetMattered classified the posting.

newestJobMatchId.description: The highest job_match_id on this page. Store it and pass it back as after_job_match_id to see only newer matches.

nextStep.description: Set when the list is empty: the one thing to do next. Follow it before calling again.

notFoundIds.description: Requested job_match_ids that do not exist on this account.

posting.description: A posting read from job_url. Nothing was saved.

title: Get Job Matches
